C-32.Name: Copy as Structured Text: plain text that keeps the document structure
C-32.Summary: User request 2026-10-14: «еще хочется формат "Скопировать как текст с адаптированным форматированием" ну то есть остаются абзацы (ссылки включаются в скобках как текст, буллиты превращаются в минусики и тому подобное)». A third copy flavor next to Copy as HTML (C-3) and Copy as Plain Text (C-12): plain text with no Markdown syntax that still reads like the document — paragraphs separated by blank lines, list items as "- " / "1. " with nested indentation, links as "text (url)", task items as "[ ]"/"[x]", block quotes with "> ", table rows with " | " between cells, code blocks verbatim.

Problem.Description: Copy as Plain Text (C-12) flattens structure: list items lose their bullets, link targets disappear, table cells run together. Normal copy yields Markdown source with ** and []() noise.
Problem.RootCause: C-12 extracts textContent from the rendered HTML, which carries no bullet, link-target or cell-separator text.
Problem.Evidence: editor.vue handleCopyAsPlainText: doc.body.textContent over marked output.

Goals.R-1: New pure util src/renderer/src/util/structuredText.js — htmlToStructuredText(html): walks the sanitized marked HTML and emits structured plain text. Blocks (p, h1-h6, pre, blockquote, ul/ol, table, hr, figure/div wrappers) are separated by one blank line; ul items "- ", ol items "N. " honouring start; nested lists indent by two spaces per level (continuation lines aligned under the item text); task items "[ ] " / "[x] " after the marker; links "text (href)", just the href when text equals href or href is a #fragment/empty; images "alt (src)" (alt only for data: URIs); br → newline; inline code/strong/em/del lose their markers; blockquote lines prefixed "> "; table rows cells joined by " | " (header row followed by nothing extra); hr → "———"; footnote refs keep their visible label.
Goals.R-2: editor.vue handleCopyAsStructuredText: same getCopyData (whole-document fallback) + marked + DOMPurify EXPORT pipeline as C-12, then htmlToStructuredText, single text/plain native writeText; failure warns with [Editor][handleCopyAsStructuredText][BLOCK_COPY_AS_STRUCTURED_TEXT] and notifies. Bus event 'copyAsStructuredText'.
Goals.R-3: Exposure: editor context menu item (id copyAsStructuredText) after Copy as Plain Text; Edit menu item edit.copy-as-structured-text (no accelerator — the Shift/Alt C slots are taken); command registry + palette description; locales contextMenu.editor.copyAsStructuredText and commands.edit.copyAsStructuredText in all ten locale pairs.
Goals.R-4: Tests: structured-text util unit suite (lists incl. nested and ordered start, tasks, links, images, quotes, tables, code, hr, br); editor-coverage pins dispatch, whole-document fallback, failure branch, bus path, and the menu layout; menu-consistency pins the Edit-menu id.

Constraints.Constraint: Reuse the C-3/C-12 marked + sanitize pipeline; one text/plain flavor.
Util is DOM-only (DOMParser) and side-effect free.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Changing C-12 Copy as Plain Text behaviour.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion:
Copying "# T

- a [l](https://x.y)
- **b**" yields "T

- a l (https://x.y)
- b".
Context menu order: Copy as HTML, Copy as Plain Text, Copy as Structured Text; Edit menu carries edit.copy-as-structured-text.
Suites green; live check in the debug build puts the expected text on the clipboard.

C-32.VerificationIntent: Util unit suite + editor-coverage + menu-consistency pins; live clipboard check in the debug build.
